title: Offline-first sync for every syncing tool
objective: Syncing apps and scripts save locally first, stay usable offline, sync whenever the remote is reachable, and never read an unreachable remote as an empty one.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md) states the offline-first convention for every syncing app or script
endurain_import pulls phone exports into the local inbox before probing Endurain; a down server leaves them queued for the next run
keepass_sync treats only a 404 as 'no remote yet'; an outage or other status skips the cycle and leaves both vaults untouched
out_of_scope: Apps extracted to their own repos (todo, diet-guard, wake-alarm, ...)
Changing the KeePass merge or CAS logic
verifier: pytest python_pkg/endurain_import 104 passed at 100% branch; bats test_keepass_sync.bats 3/3; keepass_sync.sh against a dead REMOTE_URL with a scratch vault: skip, exit 0, sha256 unchanged; check_dependency_freshness.sh --all exit 0.
